task.title: Evidence intermittent app-open failure audit ("Evidence could not be loaded.") + bounded Native resilience fix

result.summary: Root cause PROVEN outside the app: authoritative DNS ns66.domaincontrol.com serves a stale dustinginn.com zone (SOA 2026082000 vs ns65 2026090800) with no physiqueos CNAME, so resolvers that ask ns66 cache NXDOMAIN for up to 3600 s; every Native/web request then fails before reaching the Server (zero Server traffic 23:50-00:10Z; Server healthy, live/ready 200 via ondigitalocean host and pinned custom domain; home router 10.0.0.1 still NXDOMAIN at 00:33Z). Native defect PROVEN: Evidence root was the only tab root with a catch-all terminal failure, no Retry/pull/foreground retry, and blanked a loaded hub on refresh failure (Home hides the same outage with its last-known snapshot). Bounded fix c3d9d257: newest-load-wins guard, cancellation is non-terminal, failed refresh keeps the in-memory hub, classified copy, Try Again + pull to refresh + foreground retry when failed, bounded EvidenceHubLoad diagnostics. Batch 3 preview 9fa2428c keeps the locked design. Founder must fix GoDaddy DNS.

tests.summary: Build 87 lane: focused Evidence 26/0 (9 new VM reliability + production DNS-outage test), FounderServerAPITests 247/0, generic Release compile OK. Merge-tree clean vs 793462b1, 70ebf753, e9f8a957.

review.summary: Founder review of the audit and the Native candidate requested.

zero_write_audit.summary: Read-only doctl logs/spec/deployment (physiqueos-final-cutover-config), public DNS queries and health GETs only; no production mutation, no DNS change, no deploy.

decisions_required: Founder: fix GoDaddy DNS now - re-save the physiqueos CNAME (e.g. lower TTL to 600) so ns66 re-syncs; verify dig @ns66.domaincontrol.com physiqueos.dustinginn.com +norecurse returns the CNAME; open a GoDaddy case if ns66 stays on serial 2026082000
Optional durable: move dustinginn.com (or the physiqueos host) DNS to a consistent provider (Cloudflare/DigitalOcean DNS)
Authorize including Native c3d9d257 in the next build, and the Batch 3 resolution per preview 9fa2428c at final merge
blockers: Production DNS outage persists until the GoDaddy zone is re-synced (Founder action; not authorized/possible from this lane)
unexpected_findings: ns66.domaincontrol.com serves stale zone serial 2026082000 without the physiqueos CNAME; ns65 serves 2026090800 - production host intermittently NXDOMAIN with a 1 h negative cache (also takes down the web app)

Cold-launch Evidence Hub pulls ~20 MB of scope-all reads alongside Home 6.2 MB and Log 9.5 MB (Log read 3x in 10 s) on one 1 vCPU / 1 GB web instance - headroom risk vs the 15 s idle timeout, not the cause of this incident
doctl context physiqueos-audit now returns 401; physiqueos-final-cutover-config works for reads

Consider a persisted last-known Evidence Hub snapshot (new persistence - needs a decision)
Reduce scope-all Evidence Hub payloads (summary projections) and duplicate Log reads on launch
Ask Founder for one You > Network diagnostics export after the next occurrence to confirm NSURLError -1003
